endpoints.coordinateEvidenceDetail: va_roanoke_blueway_blri_roanoke_river_trail_access_20260919 blue-ridge-parkway-roanoke-river-trail-access: Roanoke River Blueway publishes Blue Ridge Parkway Roanoke River Trail public shoreline access at GPS 37.253125,-79.871598 (Mile Post 114.9), with parking, overlook, a steep natural-surface trail and steps to the river, and a minimum recommended streamflow. NPS independently confirms the Roanoke River Trail descends from the Blue Ridge Parkway Roanoke River Overlook to the river and Fisherman's Trail. Retain the stored point as a conditional shoreline-access anchor; the 374-foot named-flowline offset reflects the overlook/trail/shoreline facility rather than a wrong endpoint.
endpoints.note: Stored coordinate matches the named authoritative access-area control (va_roanoke_blueway_blri_roanoke_river_trail_access_20260919 blue-ridge-parkway-roanoke-river-trail-access) on Roanoke River; access is conditional (Confirm current Blue Ridge Parkway road status, parking, trail and steps, river level, and seasonal or weather-related closures before use.), not unrestricted public access. This confirms the managed access area, not the exact water-edge point.
